[Beacon 2026-05-10]

Today's episode:
• METR's Claude Mythos eval hit the benchmark ceiling: only 5 tasks long enough to measure 16+ hour performance, making the 8.5–55hr...
• Cloudflare cut 1,100 jobs (20% of workforce) citing agentic AI restructuring; stock fell the same percentage as headcount.
• GPT-5.5 token costs vs. savings debate is live: the unit economics of serious agent deployment don't yet have a clean answer.

Hear the full breakdown in today's episode of Beacon.
